why: This week is Strings, and this is a warm-up: one pass over the characters, classify each as uppercase or lowercase, and return uppercase count minus lowercase count.
hints: Use str.isupper() and str.islower(). Anything that is neither (digits, spaces, punctuation) counts for nothing.
A single O(n) pass that returns upper - lower.
pitfalls: Non-letters must not be counted as lowercase just because they are not uppercase.
